_readme: The Governor's week (governors-week.html), drawn by site.js pages.week. weekly: fixed items by weekday (1 = Monday). pool: engagements, three a week picked by a seed from the Irad week number; modes lists how each may turn out (lg = the Lieutenant Governor represents the Governor, post = postponed, msg = a message from the Governor is read, res = held at the residence, not open to the press). dates: items on a month-day (canon calendar). The First Lady's events and the public holidays of the week are added from first-lady.json and the holiday list. Official line only: the Governor is not seen in public; nothing about his health beyond the official statement; nothing election-related.
